records.observation: Constructor captures JTable, model cast LegendTableModel, fixed model column, initializes text/tooltip/foreground/background from model, centered; pressed background darker. Header and both tab icons initiallynull. initPressablePullDownTab creates Triangular3DIcon(1,true,raised) released and (1,false,raised) pressed using model raised flag; stores current header, text left of icon and released icon; adds new mouse listener every call without removal/idempotence. Triangle internals pending. setPressed swaps icon/background, revalidate/repaint self then header.repaint; before init header null causes NPE after local state changes. No override getTableCellRendererComponent, so inherited renderer behavior remains; do not infer fixed text from constructor alone. No sorting, popup operation, Category change or TopControl initialization. Captured table/model/header not refreshed after replacement.

records.observation: Stores outer both synthetic this$0 and renderer. Own-column test uses header.columnAtPoint(event.getPoint), then table.convertColumnIndexToModel before comparing original renderer column; column reordering accommodated. No explicit invalid-coordinate/null guard. Press and release each independently test current pointer column; press sets true, release false only if same renderer column at release. No tracked press origin, button filter, mouseExited reset or global release reset: press one column/release elsewhere can leave original pressed. Any mouse button can alter visual state. No menu show or sort; main header handler separately opens popup.

records.observation: JPopupMenu stores table and its current model cast LegendTableModel plus unchecked bool column; label/tooltip from model. Six items Toggle/Enable/Disable Selected then Toggle/Enable/Disable All; each class resource path /images/checkbox corresponding CamelCase.gif, missing URL gives null icon but menu still functional. No enable-state adjustment for empty selection. Selected operations snapshot table.getSelectedRows at action time, use each integer directly as model row without convertRowIndexToModel; existing LegendTable model sorts its own list and installs no row sorter, so this alone does not prove ordinary current-path mis-targeting, but externally installed row sorter/filter is unsupported. Popup click does not select a row per TableColumnHandler. Toggle reads Boolean and writes opposite, set writes supplied TRUE/FALSE regardless of prior value. All operations snapshot model row count then loop0..count-1; empty loops no-op. Each setValueAt immediately changes shared Category and fires cell event per previously read model; no bulk event suppression, transaction/rollback, identity snapshot, bounds/type/null checks or direct timeline redraw/file persistence. Model captured at construction, not fetched again if table model replaced. Synchronous listener/reentrant changes can leave partial effects or change later row identity. Synthetic accessors expose column and four operations. Actual callers install columns2/3; other columns not validated by this class.

records.observation: Constructor stores JTable/current header/model column/popup. mousePressed immediately returns unless SwingUtilities.isRightMouseButton. Uses table event point directly with stored JTableHeader.columnAtPoint (no coordinate conversion), converts returned view column to model index then checks designated column. Matching press shows popup on event component at original event x,y. Does not inspect/select clicked row, stop cell editing or snapshot selection; boolean menu acts on existing selection at later action. No mouseReleased/isPopupTrigger path or popup null guard; no direct category mutation.
